# tests/fixtures/quote-spans-corpus.txt
# Differential corpus for tests/unit-quote-spans-differential.sh (#1569).
# One JSON-encoded string per line (JSON so that embedded newlines, quotes and
# backslashes survive the file round-trip verbatim). `#` lines and blank lines
# are comments.
#
# Provenance is recorded per block: every case is harvested from an existing
# test, from one of the 7 historical false positives, or from the mandatory
# 14-case span table in tests/unit-quote-spans/structure.sh.

"'hello world'"
"'unclosed"
"\"hello world\""
"\"unclosed"

"echo 'branch -d'"

"git commit -m \"branch -d fix/foo\""
""
"cat <<EOF"
"VAR='x' cmd"
"MSG=\"a b\" git commit"

"\"cp\" src dst"

"echo '$(echo hi > out.txt)'"
"grep -nE \"pattern > match\" file.txt"
"gh issue comment 369 --body \"use > to redirect\""
"echo $(grep x file 2>/dev/null)"
"echo hi | tee out.txt"

# ── the mandatory 14-case span table (tests/unit-quote-spans/structure.sh) ──

"$(echo $'a\\')b')"

"$(printf ')'"

"$(( 1 + (2 * 3) ))"
